scope: ours: add mvp-mode, merge skill-router into it

subject: ours:skill-router
why: Owner 2026-10-31: one router, mvp-mode; skill-router retires into it (unit-kinds R1). Its routes moved to mvp-mode's situation table and generated catalog. The folder stays as a manual-only pointer because the plugin ships it and its record keeps its lineage and history.

subject: ours:mvp-mode
why: Owner 2026-10-31: mvp-mode is the one router (unit-kinds R1): model-invocable and kept on by one AGENTS.md line (R7); it lists every playbook and principle and skills in two layers (R3). It holds the shared rules for running a playbook and, in playbooks/, the first playbook, bug-fix.md, which calls systematic-debugging and test-driven-development whole (H9, B3).

subject: ours:systematic-debugging
why: Bug-fix pilot: the skill now reports a diagnosis and changes no production code beyond temporary instrumentation; fixing, its proof and hardening moved to the bug-fix playbook, which calls this skill. It drops owning-fix, attempt-log, two-failure-stop, regression-check, defense-in-depth-hardening, evidence-safety (left to AGENTS.md) and closeout, and adds diagnosis-only, diagnosis-status and caller-deferrable-cleanup. It withdraws the two delivered Pocock adoptions it no longer provides; the owner decides whether to retarget them to the playbook.

subject: ours:execution
why: Bug-fix pilot: systematic-debugging no longer fixes, so execution's task loop calls it for the diagnosis and carries the fix gates on its own path (fix only a confirmed cause, a regression check when feasible, rerun the original scenario, an attempt log, stop after two failed fixes). Hardening and a top-level bug-fix request route to the bug-fix playbook through mvp-mode, or to the parent from a delegated task (B11, R8).

subject: ours:performance-optimization
why: Bug-fix pilot: a regression whose cause is the main question routes to the bug-fix playbook (through mvp-mode at top level, to the parent from a delegated task, B11); the diagnosis alone is systematic-debugging.

subject: ours:mvp-mode
why: The bug-fix playbook (doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/bug-fix.md) after the S8 baseline showed two gate gaps: every fix run took step 1's skip, a flaky failure included, and the fix runs wrote test-first by hand instead of calling test-driven-development (B3). Step changes (steps diff, St3): bug-fix#1 condition changed to a deterministic failing command, run as reported, whose output points at the cause, never a flaky failure or a cause found by reading code or rerunning in a loop; bug-fix#3 gains the action existing-check-as-proof (new, variant of regression-check and original-failure-check); bug-fix#3's test-driven-development call condition changed to apply only when step 1's check does not already fail for the reported reason. obvious-cause-skip's definition, new in this round, was amended to match. The router's own text and tree hash are unchanged. S8 rerun: F2 called systematic-debugging 3/3 (baseline 0/3), F1 still skipped step 2 2/2, no production edit before a confirmed cause 8/8; F3 called test-driven-development 1/3 (baseline 0/3), short of the trial's criterion.

subject: ours:systematic-debugging
